name: character-add
description: Registers one of your characters in this server's guild

options.name: name
options.description: Name-Lastname (dash between the names, letters only, 2+ each). Forever needs a last name

options.name: main
options.description: Is this one of your main characters? (default: no)

name: character-remove
description: Removes one of your registered characters

options.name: name
options.description: Name-Lastname (dash between the names, letters only, 2+ each). Forever needs a last name

name: contact-officer
description: Send a private message to the guild's officers

options.name: message
options.description: What you want to tell the officers

options.name: anonymous
options.description: Stay anonymous to the officers (default: yes). Only the first message of a conversation counts

options.name: conversation-id
options.description: Continue an earlier conversation (the ID you were given)

options.name: image
options.description: An optional picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB)

name: contact-officer-reply
description: Officers only: reply to a member's conversation

options.name: conversation-id
options.description: The conversation ID shown on the request

options.name: message
options.description: Your reply (the member gets it by DM)

options.name: image
options.description: An optional picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB)

name: clear-channel
description: Officers only: delete all unpinned messages in a channel

options.name: channel
options.description: The channel to clear (default: the one you are in)
